facts.activity_file: setting and proving mechanical seal support systems
facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: preventive action - alarm rationalisation on TK-7102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. TK-7102 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 14 December 2019 a corrective action on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
